description: Negative control: the same PULP apb_i2c level interrupt, but the declared clear write is CMD=0x10 (a new write command) instead of CMD[0]=1 (iack). The line stays high, so the host must report level_stuck and reset the device, not mask it.
notes: This file is deliberately wrong about the clear: it proves the detector, not the device. Do not use it as a device declaration.
